definitions.explanation: Describes sake or wine that is not sweet, with a crisp, clean taste. The opposite is {甘口|あまくち} (sweet).
Describes food that has a strong, pungent heat rather than sweetness.
Used figuratively to describe someone who gives frank, unsparing criticism or evaluation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{辛口|からくち}だ。
{辛口|からくち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白|しろ}ワイン→白ワイン：16973_shirowain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
A versatile word with three distinct meanings: dry (drinks), spicy (food), and harsh (criticism).

FORMS:
{辛|から} (spicy/dry) + ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth/taste)

SIMILAR WORDS:
The antonym across all senses is ⟦{甘口|あまくち}→甘口：18197_amakuchi⟧ (sweet/mild/lenient).

SENSE 1 — DRY (DRINKS):
For sake and wine, {辛口|からくち}/⟦{甘口|あまくち}→甘口：18197_amakuchi⟧ is the primary flavor axis. {辛口|からくち} sake has a crisp, clean taste rather than being literally spicy.

SENSE 2 — SPICY (FOOD):
Used for spice levels on menus, especially curry: ⟦{甘口|あまくち}→甘口：18197_amakuchi⟧ (mild) → ⟦{中辛|ちゅうから}→中辛：18488_chuukara⟧ (medium) → {辛口|からくち} (hot)

SENSE 3 — HARSH (CRITICISM):
Figurative — describes blunt, unsparing criticism:
- {辛口|からくち}⟦コメント→コメント：06956_komento⟧: harsh comment
- {辛口|からくち}⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧: blunt review
- {辛口|からくち}⟦{評論家|ひょうろんか}→評論家：16405_hyouronka⟧: harsh critic
